english: Simulated scale exercise. These dimensions come from the app’s illustrative sample model, not a ground survey. They are not recommended bed or access widths. This is separate from the unmeasured busy-yard case.
xhosa_before: Umsebenzi wokuziqhelisa wesikali olingiswayo. Le milinganiselo ivela kwimodeli yomzekelo ye-app, ayivelanga kuphando lomhlaba. Ayiyiyo ububanzi obucetyiswayo bebhedi okanye bendlela yokungena. Oku kwahlukile kwimeko yegceke elixakekileyo elingalinganiswanga.
back_translation: Practice exercise of a simulated scale. These measurements come from the app's example model; they did not come from a survey of the land. They are not the recommended widths of a bed or of an access path. This differs from the case of the busy yard that was not measured.
note: Imilinganiselo vs ayiyiyo concord is awkward and kuphando is "research/inquiry" for survey; the negation over bed and access widths is intact and strong. Left.

back_translation: MODEL ONLY · they are not measurements of the place
note: Negation kept ("ayiyiyo imilinganiselo yendawo"); concord is awkward. Left.
Sibling drafts use umsantsa for gap (Umsantsa onikeziweyo, Umsantsa ocacileyo); "msantsi" is not that word. Meaning unchanged.

english: Prepared example of saved records. It is not a comprehensive site assessment, design report or evidence of progress. No new AI analysis.
xhosa_before: Umzekelo olungiselelweyo weerekhodi ezigciniweyo. Ayingovavanyo olubanzi lwendawo, ingxelo yoyilo okanye ubungqina benkqubela. Akukho hlalutyo lutsha lwe-AI.
back_translation: A prepared example of saved records. It is not a broad assessment of the place, a design report or proof of progress. There is no new analysis by AI.
note: Pinned by tests/report-summary-localization.test.ts, kept. All three negations (not an assessment, design report or evidence) intact; "olubanzi" is broad rather than comprehensive; "olungiselelweyo" agrees with the wrong noun class; "yoyilo" is correctly "design".

back_translation: This report was written by AI, language: {language}. It has not yet been checked by a person who speaks the language well; check the figures by comparing with the English source.
